title: My Friends and Books
text:
My name is Maria. I am thirty years old. I have forty-five books in my room. I read one book every week.

My friend Pedro is twenty-five years old. He has a dog and a cat. He has ninety-nine photos of his dog on his phone.

questions.text: How many photos of his dog does Pedro have on his phone?
What can you infer about Maria?
What can you infer about Pedro?

vocabulary.definition: a set of printed pages that you read
pictures taken with a camera or a phone

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Maria. Eu tenho trinta anos. Eu tenho quarenta e cinco livros no meu quarto. Eu leio um livro por semana.
Meu amigo Pedro tem vinte e cinco anos. Ele tem um cachorro e um gato. Ele tem noventa e nove fotos do seu cachorro no celular.
